'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Nicholas Tobin DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nicholas Tobin]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Palpatine's Ops. Nicholas Tobin / NinjaElf6, 2014 Worlds Day 2 8/23/14, 2013 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' NinjaElf6
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
